name: The Last Supper
overview: The Last Supper is a profound moment where Jesus institutes the practice of communion, symbolizing His body given for believers, as He broke bread and instructed His disciples to remember Him (Matthew 26:26; Luke 22:19; Mark 14:22). It also reveals the reality of betrayal among His closest followers (Mark 14:18) and emphasizes the necessity of partaking in Christ’s sacrifice for spiritual life (John 6:53). Ultimately, Jesus affirms Himself as the exclusive way to the Father, grounding the significance of this meal in His unique role as Savior (John 14:6).
